paragraphs.source_en: By the time Hon'ami Kōetsu arrived in Osaka with two clerks from the Chaya house, the city had already descended into uncontrollable chaos.

units.source_en: By the time Hon'ami Kōetsu arrived in Osaka with two clerks from the Chaya house, the city had already descended into uncontrollable chaos.
units.source_zh: 当本阿弥光悦带着茶屋的两名伙计来到大坂之时，大坂已陷入了无法收拾的混乱境地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当本阿弥光悦带着茶屋的两名伙计来到大坂之时，大坂已陷入了无法收拾的混乱境地。

paragraphs.source_en: The townspeople sensed that war was imminent, and the castle town was nearly deserted. Several rows of sturdy barricades had been erected from the Tennōji Gate to the Hacchōme Gate, making entry into the castle all but impossible.

units.source_en: The townspeople sensed that war was imminent, and the castle town was nearly deserted. Several rows of sturdy barricades had been erected from the Tennōji Gate to the Hacchōme Gate, making entry into the castle all but impossible.

paragraphs.source_en: “While we are at it, we should like to ask for your help as well, sir.” So they said.

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu was at a loss. Whatever calamity might befall them, they were determined to survive: such was a merchant's tenacity. Their view could not be called mistaken, but they were rather too calculating.

paragraphs.source_en: “Such are the times.” They said, “The Taikō brought the realm under his rule and fulfilled the merchants' dearest wish. Yet now there are men who delight in war. War is the merchant's greatest enemy.”

paragraphs.source_en: On hearing him say this, the others shook their heads disdainfully and dismissed it with a laugh. They had already given up entirely and were absorbed in their next scheme…

paragraphs.source_en: “Sir, have you not heard what the Minister of the Right looked like when he inspected the ground outside the castle?” Yodoya and Amagasakiya exclaimed together.

units.source_zh: “老先生，您不知右大臣巡视城外时的样子？”

units.source_en: Yodoya and Amagasakiya exclaimed together.
units.source_zh: 淀屋和尼崎屋齐声道。

paragraphs.source_en: “It seems he has finally made up his mind. It reminded me of the days when the Taikō was alive.”

paragraphs.source_en: Yet it was said that a magnificent feast was held on the very night the entire army returned to the castle. From dawn the following day, the streets were thronged with people fleeing for safety. They knew they could no longer escape trampling hooves or the flames of war.

paragraphs.source_en: “It appears they mean to fight to the bitter end.”

units.source_en: “It appears they mean to fight to the bitter end.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Osaka Castle, which did not become a battlefield even during the Battle of Sekigahara, is to be destroyed by rōnin at last.”

units.source_en: “Osaka Castle, which did not become a battlefield even during the Battle of Sekigahara, is to be destroyed by rōnin at last.”
units.source_zh: “连关原合战时都未变成战场的大坂城，终要被浪人毁掉了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “连关原合战时都未变成战场的大坂城，终要被浪人毁掉了。”

paragraphs.source_en: The outward bravado of Osaka's leaders could not win the support of the common people. The merchants hurriedly prepared to flee while anxiously making plans for the future. Realizing that their lords could neither avert war nor preserve order, they were reduced to pitiful measures of self-defense.

units.source_en: The outward bravado of Osaka's leaders could not win the support of the common people.

ることはできなかった。

units.source_en: The merchants hurriedly prepared to flee while anxiously making plans for the future.
units.source_zh: 商家们一面匆忙为逃难作准备，一面紧张地为将来筹划。

units.source_en: Realizing that their lords could neither avert war nor preserve order, they were reduced to pitiful measures of self-defense.
units.source_zh: 他们得知领主既无法避免战乱，又无力维持秩序，只能进行可悲的自卫。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大坂诸人表面的威风无法赢得庶民的拥戴。商家们一面匆忙为逃难作准备，一面紧张地为将来筹划。他们得知领主既无法避免战乱，又无力维持秩序，只能进行可悲的自卫。

paragraphs.source_en: To anyone's eyes this was a war with no hope of victory. The people could hardly submit in their hearts to lords bent on defending the castle, and their reverence for the late Taikō now collapsed completely. Rumors then began to circulate among the people that the retired shogun intended to burn Osaka to the ground. Their discussions led them to conclude that once the war ended and peace returned to the realm, Osaka would be not only a military stronghold but also a place where wealth gathered.

units.source_en: To anyone's eyes this was a war with no hope of victory. The people could hardly submit in their hearts to lords bent on defending the castle, and their reverence for the late Taikō now collapsed completely.

paragraphs.source_zh: 无论在谁眼里，这都是一场毫无胜机的战事，因此众人自然无法对铁了心据城一战的领主心服，对已故太阁的崇拜亦在此时完全崩塌。民间遂开始议论，大御所欲将大坂烧成一片焦土。议论的结果，乃是待战事结束，天下太平，大坂将不仅是军事要塞，还是钱财聚集之地。

paragraphs.source_en: “Naturally, the retired shogun means to make money here.” Once they had reached that conclusion, who cared whether Hideyori and his mother lived or died?

units.source_en: If Hideyori would willingly move to Kōriyama and thereby preserve Osaka's prosperity, the people would gladly offer their hard-earned money to build him a new castle.

paragraphs.source_en: Even so, Kōetsu did not give up. He firmly believed that Ieyasu's true desire was to save Hideyori. He also knew that Hideyori himself had never wished for this misfortune. If he stood by and did nothing, sunlight would never brighten the world.

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu decided to visit Omitsu, now the wife of Chaya, at Sakai harbor and consult her about his desire to see Hideyori. But Omitsu no longer had any connection with Hideyori. She now wished to distance herself from Osaka and was striving to forget the child she had left beside Senhime. She told Kōetsu, “Go to Shuri's chief retainer, Yonemura Gon'emon, and see whether he can find a way.”

paragraphs.source_zh: 光悦决定到堺港造访现已成为茶屋夫人的阿蜜，与她商议欲一见秀赖。但阿蜜已与秀赖全无瓜葛，她现在正欲疏远大坂，努力忘掉留在千姬身边的孩子。她对光悦道：“去找修理的家老米村权右卫门，看看有无办法。”

paragraphs.source_en: Yonemura Gon'emon often came to Sakai harbor in search of news and was therefore well acquainted with Kōetsu. Moreover, for Omitsu's sake, he might be able to get Kōetsu inside the castle if he asked to see Hideyori. Kōetsu decided to try.

units.source_en: Yonemura Gon'emon often came to Sakai harbor in search of news and was therefore well acquainted with Kōetsu. Moreover, for Omitsu's sake, he might be able to get Kōetsu inside the castle if he asked to see Hideyori.

paragraphs.source_en: Because Kōetsu had once met Obama Mitsutaka, he finally obtained permission and boarded a fishing boat from the village of Tsukudajima. It was already twilight when he stood before Osaka's heavily guarded main gate.

paragraphs.source_en: After a long wait, Kōetsu finally received an unexpected reply: “Lord Yonemura is away. Lord Shuri wishes to receive Master Hon'ami in person.”

units.source_en: After a long wait, Kōetsu finally received an unexpected reply: “Lord Yonemura is away. Lord Shuri wishes to receive Master Hon'ami in person.”

paragraphs.source_en: Evidently, the messenger had heard the name “Chaya” and reported Kōetsu's visit directly to Harunaga. For Kōetsu, this was exactly what he had hoped for.
